question: How is the tenth procedure identified in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya?
premises: The text names its procedures sequentially
This section concerns examining seasons and days
inference: The tenth procedure in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya is named the examination of seasons and other days.
plain_english: Thus, in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya, the tenth procedure is named the examination of seasons and other days.
